answer: Recursive ZK reputation commitments bind identities while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces any clone to exceed the work bound. Staking collateral is locked and slashing penalties erase the stake, yielding negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium. The walnut commitment layer anchors recursion, an ember seeds the VRF sortition, and the ferrous substrate guarantees collision resistance. The protocol thus achieves sybil resistance under adaptive adversaries.
